note: 1:1 with m42ed54_run_state. Three states of a record (dword +0x4d): 0 (start: rand, clamp, table reset, 4 host calls), 1 (jump table of 4 sub-steps at 0x42f500, the dword 0x5b5162) and 2 (load of the globals 0x5bb57b.. from one of two record blocks, flag-table store, 0x42ba3a). Direct test: ordered host calls with hand-derived arguments, call-time probes of every global and table, signed/unsigned boundaries, the jump-table bounds. Differential test: original bytes (Unicorn, rand/callees/GetTickCount as recording stubs) vs native on 300 random fixtures, every instruction of the 1964-byte body reached, jump table included. The CRT rand at 0x50cd50 is a host call whose result is scripted; the idiv by 5 is part of the function and runs as original code.

Direct test: ordered host calls with hand-derived arguments, call-time probes of self, the item table and the record state, word-argument masks, wrap-arounds, the rejection of captions longer than 200 bytes. Differential test: original bytes (Unicorn, callees and GetTickCount as recording stubs, the bytes behind the frame pointer of 0x448d11 compared) vs native on 300 random fixtures, every instruction of the 2713-byte body reached.
